definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
  b."BATCH_ID",
  CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
  'S4_CURR' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
  o."SOURCE_FILE",
  "d"."InternalOrder","d"."InternalOrderDescription","d"."OrderCategory","d"."BusinessArea","d"."ControllingArea","d"."Plant","d"."Currency","d"."IsStatisticalOrder","d"."ReferenceOrder","d"."SalesOrder","d"."SalesOrderItem","d"."WBSElement","d"."WBSElementInternalID","d"."RequestingCostCenter","d"."RequestingCompanyCode","d"."RequestingOrder","d"."InternalOrderLocation","d"."LocationPlant","d"."ExternalOrder","d"."ActualPostedCostCenter","d"."PlanningWithLineItemsIsActive","d"."CostCenter","d"."LogicalSystem","d"."OrdIsUsedInIntegratedPlanning","d"."TaxJurisdiction","d"."ResultAnalysisInternalID","d"."ConditionUsage","d"."ConditionApplication","d"."CostingSheet","d"."OverheadCode","d"."OrderInterestCalcProfile","d"."IntOrderSettlementCostElement","d"."BasicSettlementGLAccount","d"."IntOrderIndividualField1Value","d"."IntOrderIndividualField2Value","d"."IntOrderIndividualField3Value","d"."IntOrderIndividualField4Value","d"."IntOrderIndividualField5Amount","d"."IntOrderIndividualField6Date","d"."IntOrderIndividualField7Value","d"."IntOrderIndividualField8Date","d"."IntOrderIndividualField9Date","d"."IntOrderIndividualField10Value","d"."OrderProcessingGroup","d"."InvestmentProfile","d"."InvestmentScale","d"."InvestmentReason","d"."EnvironmentalInvestmentReason","d"."JointVenture","d"."JointVentureRecoveryCode","d"."JointVentureEquityType","d"."JointVentureOriginalCostObject","d"."JointVentureObjectType","d"."JointVentureClass","d"."JointVentureSubClass","d"."IsDeleted","d"."CreationDate","d"."CreationTime","d"."CreatedByUser","d"."LastChangedByUser","d"."LastChangeDate","d"."LastChangeTime","d"."ControllingObject","d"."CompanyCode","d"."ProfitCenter","d"."FunctionalArea","d"."ControllingObjectClass","d"."OrderType","d"."ResponsibleCostCenter","d"."InternalOrderResponsibleUser","d"."IntOrderPlannedReleaseDate","d"."IntOrderPlannedCompletionDate","d"."IntOrderPlannedClosingDate","d"."InternalOrderReleaseDate","d"."InternalOrderCompletionDate","d"."InternalOrderClosingDate","d"."CostCollector"
FROM
  "1_INBOUND_S4_CURR.1LT_I_INTERNALORDER_S4_CURR" d
  CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_S4_CURR_01" b
  JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID"
  AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'S4_CURR'
  AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'I_INTERNALORDER'
